title: Genotypic variation in blueberry flower morphology and nectar reward content affects pollinator attraction in a diverse breeding population.
summary: Machine-learning prediction models using flower traits and visitation measurements identified trait associations with bee visitation and pollination indices in blueberry genotypes; this is a measured, species-specific result. AI role: Machine-learning models relating flower traits to pollination measurements. The article appeared in Bmc Plant Biology.
